Round 25 (SRW-13 stage 1) is implemented, and every gate I ran passes. Nothing is marked PASS: C still has to run all the R25 checks.

**What changed** (exactly the files ┬º3.2 allows):
- **Model and type:** a required `master: { gainDb, mute }` field, the ΓêÆ60ΓÇª+6 dB range, `setMasterMix` (returns the same object when nothing changes), `masterLinearGain` and the readout formatter.
- **Graph:** a `masterGain` option and `setMasterGain`, using 3 ms into or out of mute and 15 ms otherwise, and doing nothing after disconnect.
- **Export:** the offline render applies the same Master. It measures the peak and the clipped-sample count before the clamp, and the clamp itself is unchanged. On overload the export state gets an optional `warning`; all other states stay exactly `{ phase, message }`. Exporting while muted still writes a real silent file and adds the mute suffix to the done message.
- **Context:** Master Mute, plus Master Volume with the same drag, keyboard, blur, Undo and Redo behaviour as track Volume. It uses separate Master tracking alongside the track Volume code. The only change to the track code is a few added calls that save a pending Master edit first. A Master change never rebuilds the playing graph, because `scheduleKey` is unchanged.
- **UI:** the new `ArrangementMaster.tsx` sits in the header before the demo badge. The only changes to `StudioWorkspace.tsx` are the import and the header render. The export dialog gets the mute note, the gain note and the overload alert.
- **Doc 031** (Georgian).

**Tests:**
- **Red first:** before any source change, the 15 cases in `master.test.ts` all failed on the live tree. `master-ui.test.tsx` could not load there, so I proved it red in a scratch copy outside `store/` with a stub component. The final test files fail 35/35 on the snapshot sources.
- **New tests:** 35 new `it` blocks, all green.
- **Full suite:** 1045/1045 (1010 + 35).
- **Other gates:** tsc clean and build passes. Biome on `./app` shows 0 errors and the same 218 warnings + 1 info as round 24.
- **Frozen tests:** `render-budget`, `export-dialog-focus`, `graph` and `ArrangementContext` are green and unchanged.
- **Hashes and status:** 50/50 frozen files OK and protected files 4/4 OK. `Header.tsx` is unchanged (+21/ΓêÆ0). `git status` has exactly 54 lines.

**Code review** (the real `code-reviewer` agent): no Critical or High findings.
- I fixed both Medium findings by adding tests. They cover that the export really applies the Master gain and measures before the clamp, and that cancelling a drag, unmounting mid-drag and a refused drag all behave correctly.
- I documented the Low items in doc 031: one theoretical Undo edge case (two pending fader edits at once, which can't happen today) and floating-point rounding at exact boundaries.

**Browser smoke check** (my own state file, on the existing :5173 server):
- The header is 35 px at both 1440 and 1280. The transport is 49 px at 1440 and 87 px at 1280.
- A Master Mute click toggles `aria-pressed`.
- 12 ArrowDown presses give `ΓêÆ6.0 dB` and the Undo label `Master Volume`. Home and End give `ΓêÆ60.0 dB` and `+6.0 dB` with no text clipping.
- Chrome exposes a group named "Master". The only console errors are the known anonymous cart errors.

**Deviations C should check:**
- I used `<fieldset aria-label="Master">` instead of `div role="group"`, because Biome rejects the div. Chrome shows it as a group named Master, but C should confirm in its own tree.
- The warning's peak value is floored at `+0.0` so it never prints `+-0.0`.
- There is no `/check` skill in the project, so I ran Biome scoped to my files plus a read-only run on `./app`.
- My Home check started from position 0, so it does not prove that Home on the fader doesn't seek. C needs to check that from a non-zero position.
